message.content:
This is a tabletop of plywood core with copper-clad sheet metal surface, imported as a furniture part. Furniture parts fall under 9403.99 ("Parts of furniture, other"). Parts of metal furniture go to 9403.99.10 (of metal) and wooden furniture parts to 9403.99.90 (other, including wood). Subheading 9403.99.90 splits further: 9403.99.9010 for parts of household furniture, and 9403.99.9045 for other.

The essential character question is whether the tabletop is wood or metal. The plywood core makes up the bulk of the volume and weight (the copper layer is only 1 mm), so wood gives the essential character. That points to 9403.91.00 (parts of wooden furniture), not 9403.99. Heading 9403.91.00 covers "Parts: Of wood." The statistical suffix is 9403.91.0080.

Although the copper surface is the visible face, the plywood provides the structure. I'm choosing the wooden-parts classification.
